categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h to implement request completion deadlines on the HTTP server, carrying the RPC/REST/ZMQ area label.
categories.rationale: This PR mitigates a denial-of-service vulnerability where unauthenticated clients can exhaust all HTTP connection slots by trickling request bytes indefinitely. As the description demonstrates, trickling a single byte every ten seconds repeatedly resets the idle read timer and bypasses `-rpcservertimeout`, preventing legitimate callers from connecting since connection slots are capped by default at 16.
